title: Bubble and Squeak with Pumpkin Mash
description: A traditional British dish, Bubble and Squeak is made with leftover potatoes and cabbage, pan-fried until crispy. In this recipe, we've added a seasonal twist by incorporating roasted pumpkin and a hint of unique spices.
instructions: 2. Toss the pumpkin cubes with a drizzle of olive oil and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
3. In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
4. Add the shredded cabbage and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
5. Stir in the mashed potatoes, umami broth, salt, and pepper.
6. Use a spatula to shape the mixture into patties.
7. Pan-fry the patties until crispy and golden brown, about 4-5 minutes per side.
8. Serve the Bubble and Squeak hot, topped with roasted pumpkin mash and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
